title: Matching certificate test
statement: For a Boolean string $z$, return true exactly when all four conditions hold: the prescribed width-aware encoding equality holds for the first component of $z$, the product encoding built from its two decoded parameters has length equal to the decoded witness length, the product encoding built from the first parameter and the decoded parameter $tNK$ has length at most the second decoded component's length, and the integer represented by the decoded determinant component is nonzero.
caveat: The encoding and decoding operations and the meanings of the decoded parameters are not defined in the supplied material, so the conditions cannot be rendered more specifically without risking inaccuracy.
